context.body: Priestly speech is presented as the means by which God promises to bless.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD gives words by which priests place the divine name on Israel: blessing, keeping, light, grace, attention, and peace.
observations.label: God places the name in blessing: action

observations.body: Aaron and his sons speak the blessing; Israel receives the named favor.
observations.label: God places the name in blessing: response

observations.body: bless · keep · face shine · peace · put my name
observations.label: Words in Numbers 6:22–27

payload.posture: Read Numbers 6:22–27 as presence in the wilderness evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage distinguishes human speakers from God as the giver of the blessing.
payload.title: God places the name in blessing
